notes.title: UNSPOKEN FINAL UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello, dear player! As you may see, this is the "final" update for Unspoken. Not really tho, because the game will receive small fixes and language updates if needed, but generally I'm already moving on to creating new project. 
   This was a great experience in my life, and a great success! Of course, the game is far from perfect, but it's still unbelievable feedback and financial support for a 19 years old guy. I want to thank you all, who played or will play the game, who will give their reviews and feedback to help me improve! 
  Next project is very ambitious, and as it will go into active production - I will let you know. So anyone interested will hear from me here or on the developers page, social will be created later. So, onto the patch note.

[h1]Patch note. [/h1]

[olist]
[*] 10 new achievements added, for those who wanted.
[*] Small developer notes mode, that activates from in-game pause menu.
[*] 5 languages translated by native speakers, and more will come, you can leave requests and offer help.
[*] And of course some bugs are fixed as usual.
[/olist]

That's all for now, sorry for the wait time, I was a little busy and tired. A lot of things are coming in the future, it's a start of something new and cool, screenshot this message :). Bye!

notes.title: KEYS NOT WORKING
notes.content:
Hi! I see that some people get a strange bug, when their keys are not working. This is very disappointing, because I just cant get this bug myself, and I don't see how I can fix it.}

What I can suggest:

1. Reinstall the game.

2. Play with ENGLISH keyboard (yes, you heard it right, this can potentially solve the problem).

3. Maybe try windowed game mode, maybe drop and pick up the key again.

Sorry for all of those who got this bug, I'm trying my best ;((

notes.title: UNSPOKEN IS SEEKING NATIVE SPEAKERS FOR TRANSLATIONS
notes.content:
Hi! I have recently received several requests for the translation of the game, and offers from native speakers. I decided to create a guide and post file for anyone willing to help with translation. 

[h1]Requirements[/h1]

The only thing required - is your knowledge of English language at a good level, to understand the context and be able to preserve the sense of of original text.

ANY language of translation is accepted. Of course, the most desirable languages for me to add right now, are European and Asia languages, Asians specifically. But any real language, no matter how common it is - will be added in the game.

[h1]How will this work?[/h1]

Firstly, you will need to download 2 files from google drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OJfg-TgNCDYpTMfnyjTKa7f7co-z1Hyl/view?usp=sharing

One file opens with text editor, and contains in-game text, that needs to be translated.
Second file is graphic guide, how to navigate in this file and how to translate.

After translating the game, you will need to send it to email mentioned in guide. Please, attache little description about you, what is your native language that you translated in, to make my work faster and easier.

[h1]What will you get from it?[/h1]

1.My big gratitude :3
2.A Place in games credits
3.Opportunity to translate any of my future projects before their release, if you will want it

[h2]UPD[/h2]

Ready translations:
French
Spanish
Italian
Portuguese
Chinese
German
Swedish
Arabic
Polish

Thanks
